subject: Game Theory
title: Distributive vs. Integrative Bargaining
description: A quick win: understand Distributive vs. Integrative Bargaining.

hook.text: Distributive bargaining fights over a fixed pie. Integrative bargaining tries to make the pie bigger.

buildup.text: Haggling over a car price is distributive: one side's gain is the other's loss. Zero-sum.

discovery.text: Integrative deals find trades: 'I care about delivery speed, you care about price. Let's trade.'

twist.text: Most real negotiations have both elements. Even win-win deals eventually face a distributive slice.

climax.text: Great negotiators first expand the pie (integrative) then divide it (distributive).

quiz.question: What is integrative bargaining?
options: Finding ways to increase total value for both sides
